title: CJ Olive Young says unauthorized outside access to its internal business systems exposed some personal data of employees, partner staff and customers
date_note: Hankook Ilbo says Olive Young disclosed the incident on 26 November, the page's own day; the page says the access happened on the 23rd.
geo_basis: The page names no city for the company or the victims; country centre of South Korea
summary: CJ Olive Young said on 26 November that unauthorized outside access to its internal business systems occurred on the 23rd and some customer personal data was leaked. It says the leaked data is confirmed to cover 639 employees, 106 partner-company staff and 45 general customers. Payment information and passwords were not leaked, the company says.
plain: Olive Young says someone outside gained unauthorized access to its internal systems and the data of employees, partner staff and customers leaked. The company says payment information and passwords were not leaked.
exec: A retailer's internal systems were accessed without authorization, exposing data of employees, partner staff and customers; the company says payment information and passwords were not leaked.

evidence.quote: 임직원 639명, 협력사 관계자 106명, 일반 고객 45명 등 약 790명의 정보가 유출된 것으로 확인된다.
CJ올리브영은 23일 회사 업무 시스템에 대한 외부 비인가 접근이 발생해 고객 개인정보 일부가 유출됐다고 26일 밝혔다.

validation.note: Hankook Ilbo only, relaying the company's 26 November statement; no company page and no second publisher read.
